x: Charlie Walker set off on the second leg in great style with Eddie Ellis of TVH breathing down his neck. These two battled throughout and soon disposed of Walton, Blackheath and Highgate but Ealing represented by Blagrove, Brighton with Briault, and Woodford with Chapman were making faster progress…

In those early halcyon days he beat most of his contempories - names like George Knight, Peter Driver, Ken Harland, Eddie Ellis, Jack Heywood and Ian Boyd - and, no doubt, he is tempted at times to think of what might have been.
